turn.context: Tojo · new rule: learning from your replies
turn.subject: reply-check-rule
turn.user_message: Fine also counts as a miss. The rating comes before Tojo works out the turn. How would this rule create the feedback for us to approve and implement?

text: Noted. Fine and Bad both count as a miss. On a rating turn, a Good lets Tojo answer the waiting message. Fine or Bad sends him back to the rules, references and playbook first, without waiting for a second miss.
The learning works in three layers. Tojo tags every turn as he writes it. A separate review runs every night over all the tags. Only your team can turn a suggestion into a rule.
bullets: Tojo cannot judge himself fairly in the middle of a chat, so he only records. The nightly review compares many chats and writes the suggestions.
A suggestion reaches you only once the same cause shows up in several chats, or once it is serious. One person's habit stays with that person and does not become a rule.
